The main takeaway from our work is that
the hydrodynamic description of heavy ion collisions is robust and reliable, but it is not yet possible to extract the specific shear viscosity from the experimental data.
the hydrodynamization time scale is a key parameter for the modeling of heavy-ion collisions, but that it cannot be determined by the data alone.
